_arch_note: GATED HYBRID FFN diagnostic (tasks d6f887fa / c3568d03 / 1be18971). Each block runs a standard dense 4x GELU FFN and a plain-0207 LightMHL LUT branch IN PARALLEL on the same normalized input h=ln2(x), combined by a learned per-layer CONVEX gate: o = g_l*FFN(h) + (1-g_l)*LUT(h), g_l=sigmoid(theta_l), theta init 0 (g=0.5). Reads off which layers prefer dense vs LUT. PRIMARY run: lambda=0 (NO L1 penalty) -- the convex gate already forces the two branches to compete (weights sum to 1). The L1 FFN-sparsity penalty (lambda*sum_l g_l) is wired behind hybrid_lambda and left OFF here; only a fallback if gates collapse to FFN-everywhere. LUT branch = exp_g_0207 geometry exactly: lut_impl light, cell_mode constant, confidence_form margin, H=8 tph=64 nap=8 read_top_n=1, inner_in=inner_out=48, full-rank compress (H*48=384=d_model). Dense branch = 4x GELU (d_ff=1536, bias=False). Both branch outputs zeroed at init (mlp last Linear + decompress weight) so the block starts ~0, gate 0.5. 16k steps, seed 1, same optimizer/lr as g-series (lr 3e-4 wd 0.1 warmup 0.1, device_batch 12 x grad_accum 4 = 24576 eff), corrected fixed eval bs48x100 skip12. Per-layer g_l logged to metrics.csv (columns gate_L0..gate_L5) at every eval -> full gate trajectory. Launched CO-RESIDENT with exp_n_0216 on the H100 (GPU sharing approved); both time-slice, run slower, no OOM. TRITON_CACHE_DIR set in wrapper.
